Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: User Data
Fields.Description: A value for the game's own use; Havok doesn't read it.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The node's name. Used to find it in the outline and in the action scripts; it doesn't have to be unique.

Fields.Name: Enable
Fields.Description: Whether the modifier runs. A disabled modifier leaves the pose it's given unchanged.

Fields.Name: Handle
Fields.Description: The handle evaluated, usually bound to a variable.

Fields.Name: Extrapolation Time Step
Fields.Description: How far ahead the handle's position is extrapolated, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Handle Change Speed
Fields.Description: How fast the output moves to a new handle, when the change mode is constant velocity.

Fields.Name: Handle Change Mode
Fields.Description: How the output moves to a new handle: at once (abrupt) or at a constant velocity.
